visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a lavish seafood platter held by hands in a brown shirt, featuring large shrimp, clams, and sliced scallops with lemon. Dry ice smoke swirls around the dish. The background is a dark restaurant setting with warm spotlighting highlighting the food textures. (2) A person's hands are seen scooping multiple flavors of ice cream into a traditional yellow and blue bowl. The scene shifts to a freezer displaying several tubs of ice cream with branding visible. Waffle cones are added to the bowl, emphasizing the dessert selection. (3) The camera focuses on various meat platters, specifically marbled beef slices arranged elegantly on black plates with purple orchids. A pair of metal tongs lifts a slice of beef to show its high-quality marbling. Dry ice containers on the plates emit white vapor for dramatic effect. (4) Close-up shots of a dual-sided hotpot (Yin-Yang style) filled with boiling spicy red broth and a creamy white herbal broth. A ladle scoops up pieces of duck blood and tofu from the spicy side, while another shows whole ginseng roots in the white soup. (5) The scene transitions to the restaurant's unique amenities. A person is seen relaxing in a high-tech orange massage chair while using a phone. Another shot shows a colorful, dedicated kids' play area with toys and dollhouses. A yellow traditional fan is opened by a hand. (6) The final phase shows an ornate restaurant interior with dragon-themed wall art and wooden furniture. A meat 'cake' made of rolled beef slices topped with meat roses and birthday candles is displayed. The video ends with a shot of a large Terracotta Warrior statue at the entrance.

(4) [Subtitle]: 想吃更豐盛推薦直上1288專案. [Subtitle]: 不僅能吃到美澳雙和牛. [Subtitle]: Q彈牛舌. [Subtitle]: 特A級松阪豬. (5) [Subtitle]: 每人都加贈巨大手臂蝦一隻. [Subtitle]: 搭配牛肉滷三寶. [Subtitle]: 手工丸子. [Subtitle]: 腐竹和米血糕. (6) [Subtitle]: 湯底一定要點宮廷麻辣鍋. [Subtitle]: 鴨血豆腐無限續. [Subtitle]: 甘醇的貴妃美人養生湯. [Subtitle]: 有加整條人參. (7) [Subtitle]: 這裡的器皿都超霸氣. [Subtitle]: 店內還有設置皇帝大龍椅. [Subtitle]: 提供龍袍、鳳袍、服裝道具. [Subtitle]: 免費體驗宮廷變裝秀. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, welcoming tone. The background music is an upbeat, high-tempo pop track with a strong electronic beat. A subtle bubbling sound effect accompanies the visual of the hotpot. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect occurs as the scene transitions to the ice cream. The narrator's pitch rises when mentioning the brand name 'Häagen-Dazs'. A muffled scraping sound of the ice cream scoop is audible in the background. (3) The vocal delivery becomes faster and more excited as the meat varieties are listed. A splash sound effect is timed with the beef slice being dipped into the broth. The BGM remains consistent with a driving rhythm. (4) As the amenities are introduced, a soft mechanical whirring sound representing the massage chair is briefly heard. The narrator maintains a high arousal level throughout the descriptions. The BGM levels remain slightly below the clear vocal narration. (5) The final segment features a celebratory tone from the speaker. The music swells slightly in volume during the closing slogan. A brief mechanical 'click' marks the transition to the final terracotta statue shot.
